title: A finite module over a Noetherian ring has finitely many associated primes
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $M$ a finite (finitely generated) $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Call a prime ideal $\mathfrak p\subset R$ an *associated prime* of $M$ if there is $z\in M$ whose annihilator $\{a\in R: az=0\}$ equals $\mathfrak p$, and write $\operatorname{Ass}(M)$ for the set of associated primes of $M$. Then $\operatorname{Ass}(M)$ is a finite set.
